title.narrative: Contribution pluriannuelle (2021-2024) au “Multi Donor Trust Fund Extractives Global Programmatic Support 2” (EGPS-2)

description.narrative: The Contribution pluriannuelle (2021-2024) to the Multi Donor Trust Fund Extractives Global Programmatic Support 2 (EGPS-2) is a multi-partner initiative focused on government and civil society, particularly tax policy and tax administration in the extractive industries sector. The project aims to build upon lessons learned from EGPS Phase 1 (EGPS-1), continuing objectives of improving transparency, poverty alleviation, shared prosperity, economic diversification, and sustainable growth in resource-rich developing countries. The EGPS-2 seeks to address the unmet demand for non-Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) projects and close the EITI funding gap by considering additional funding from Steering Committee governments and coordinating activities with the EITI Board for a collaborative effort to mobilize additional funding. The project supports various country and regional/global activities in Africa, Asia, and other regions, including Somalia, Tanzania, Togo, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Chad, Cote d'Ivoire, Ethiopia, Nigeria, and Laos, among others. Activities range from supervision and preparation, economic impact assessments, EITI support projects, post-compliance implementation support, petroleum sector diagnostics, and local content framework development.
